query: In summary, in this paper we showed that the gene expression dynamics driven by a French Flag mechanism can be indistinguishable from those driven by a threshold-free mechanism. We then suggested a test to differentiate between the two cases and carried it out experimentally in the beetle Tribolium castaneum. The test confirmed that the AP fate specification in Tribolium (and possibly other insects) is based on the regulation of an aperiodic clock of gap genes in a threshold-free fashion.

We then suggested a test to differentiate between the two cases and carried it out experimentally in the beetle Tribolium castaneum. The test confirmed that the AP fate specification in Tribolium (and possibly other insects) is based on the regulation of an aperiodic clock of gap genes in a threshold-free fashion.
